skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominators
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions that already have the same denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions by first finding a common denominator.

skills.name: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number as an improper fraction for computation.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number in subtraction
skills.definition: When subtracting a mixed number from a whole number or another mixed number, convert one unit into fractional parts.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its simplest form by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
